name: BRAWNDO Hydration Depot
address: 1 Electrolyte Way, Bay 14, Dock C, Sundale Commerce Annex, Lot 7700
about: BRAWNDO Hydration Depot supplies electrolytes at residential, municipal, and watershed scale. It's got what you crave, and it has had it since the founding of the depot. Water is available elsewhere.
announcement: DOCK NOTICE: Orders above 275 gallons are delivered to the curb and become the household's problem at the curb.

menu.name: The Drum Line
menu.blurb: Hydration sold by displacement volume. Forklift access recommended and not provided.

items.name: The Personal Drum
items.desc: Fifteen gallons, sized for one adult and their immediate obligations. It's got electrolytes.
items.imagePrompt: Ultra-premium commercial food photography for a delivery-app menu tile. Subject: a squat fifteen-gallon electric-cyan sports-drink drum, lid cracked open, luminous cyan liquid surging over the rim and sheeting down the ribbed sidewall into a spreading puddle, a thick foam collar sagging over the bung, condensation beading across the plastic. Three-quarter hero angle from slightly below so the drum looms. Setting: an industrial warehouse floor with stacked blue plastic drums and carbon-fiber panels, hazard-yellow floor striping. Lighting: hard cyan rim light with hazard-yellow kicker, wet condensation highlights, electrical arc glow, aggressive high-contrast product photography. Camera: 50mm, f/4, deep contrast, crisp speculars. Square crop, subject centered and filling the frame. Deadpan hyperreal advertising realism. No text, no logos, no packaging labels, no hands, no people.

items.imagePrompt: Amateur smartphone photo taken by a depot employee to upload to a food delivery app. Subject: a heavy paving-stone-sized brick of set cyan electrolyte concentrate, coarse white salt crust along its top edges and one corner slumping, sitting on a sheet of wax paper inside an open white foam takeout clamshell container, the hinged foam lid folded back flat behind it, a slick of cyan syrup pooled in the bottom of the container. Harsh direct on-camera flash, hot blown-out white hotspot on the wet brick, hard black shadow thrown behind the container. The container sitting directly on a scratched laminate counter with crumbs and a smear of cyan syrup beside it. Flat phone-camera look, unretouched, mixed white balance, visible sensor noise.
